remaining_match_seconds.target_name: remaining match duration after ten minutes
remaining_match_seconds.instruction: At the ten-minute mark of this professional Dota 2 match, estimate how many more seconds will elapse before the match ends.
remaining_match_seconds.field_description: radiant_heroes and dire_heroes list the five heroes drafted by each side. radiant_earned_gold and dire_earned_gold give the total gold earned by each side through minute ten.
